purpose: Rapid ACT development test of bounded group-triggered joint replanning without historical action fusion.

baseline.reuse_rule: Authoritative repaired fresh-environment result is reused; M0 is run only in the one-state live pairing smoke.

cohort.task_selection: Frozen exposed development cohort; no outcome-based selection.

cohort_task_specs.task_name: pick up the bbq sauce and place it in the basket
pick up the black bowl between the plate and the ramekin and place it on the plate
put the wine bottle on top of the cabinet
put the black bowl in the bottom drawer of the cabinet and close it

policy.query: policy.predict_action_chunk followed by native policy and environment postprocessors

execution.principle: Every query replaces the executable plan with its newest ACT chunk; no historical chunk contributes after a new query.
execution.action_source: At physical target t, execute newest_chunk[t-q] from the current query q.

arm_phase.normalization: Each motion sequence is divided by median of its first-16-action increments plus epsilon.
arm_phase.local_minimum: v_arm[k] <= v_arm[k-1] and v_arm[k] <= v_arm[k+1]; k=15 is rejected because k+1 is unavailable.

gripper_event.intent_contract: Existing ACT contract: value >= 0 is open (+1), value < 0 is close (-1).
gripper_event.event: Earliest k with intent(a_gripper[k]) != intent(a_gripper[k-1]); otherwise 16.

nearby_boundary.definition: Two nominated boundaries are nearby when abs(h_arm-h_grip) <= 1.

pairing.construction_and_reset_seed: Environment construction and reset use the identical environment seed for every method/state pair.
pairing.common_prefix: Compare actions, simulator states, and observations only until the earliest method-specific first re-query; divergence after a legitimate dynamic re-query is allowed.

analysis.test: Exact two-sided McNemar descriptive paired comparison; no threshold sweep or post-outcome trigger modification.
analysis.h_temp: Optional post-hoc descriptive association only, using the already frozen outcome-blind artifact; never used in execution.

smolvla.gate: Only run after an explicit later approval; ACT returned SINGLE_TRIGGER_BETTER.
smolvla.cohort: same four development tasks, states 10--19, and seeds 2000--2009
smolvla.pairing: fresh identically seeded environment per method/state with common-prefix validation
smolvla.flow_rng: key by policy, task, state, environment seed, and physical query step q; method-independent
smolvla.scope: M2 only; no adaptive threshold changes, historical action fusion, or blind task evaluation

decision.label: SINGLE_TRIGGER_BETTER
decision.basis: M2=35/40 exceeds M0=32/40; M1=30/40 and M3=31/40; M2 has 3 candidate-only and 0 reference-only paired outcomes versus M0.
